declarations.description:
Renders a QR code from a string as a crisp inline SVG, with optional logo
overlay, reshaped modules and finder eyes, a gradient fill, and an artistic
"image behind the modules" mode. Output scales without aliasing and prints
cleanly.

Accessibility: the SVG carries `role="img"` and an accessible name. By
default the name is derived from `value`; set `label` to describe the
destination in human terms (e.g. "Open the Fluid docs"). When a `logo` is
embedded the logo is decorative (the QR still encodes the same `value`), so
its description stays the host's responsibility via `label`, matching the
pre-existing name mechanism.

members.name: value
members.description: Data to encode.

members.name: size
members.description: Pixel size of the rendered code.

members.name: ecLevel
members.description:
Error correction level. Note: when `logo` is set (or `artistic` is on) this
is forced to `H` internally so the covered modules still scan.

members.name: fill
members.description: Foreground (module) color. Falls back to the `--fluid-qr-color` token.

members.name: background
members.description: Background color behind the code. Falls back to the `--fluid-qr-bg` token.

members.name: margin
members.description: Module margin (the quiet zone, in modules).

members.name: label
members.description:
Human-readable accessible name for the code. When empty, the name is
derived from `value`.

members.name: moduleShape
members.description: Shape of the data modules.

members.name: eyeShape
members.description: Shape of the three finder eyes.

members.name: eyeColor
members.description: Finder-eye color. Falls back to the `--fluid-qr-eye-color` token (then the module color).

members.name: eyeColorTopLeft
members.description: Optional per-eye color override for the top-left finder.

members.name: eyeColorTopRight
members.description: Optional per-eye color override for the top-right finder.

members.name: eyeColorBottomLeft
members.description: Optional per-eye color override for the bottom-left finder.

members.name: gradientFrom
members.description: Optional linear gradient start color for module fill. Both ends required to take effect.

members.name: gradientTo
members.description: Optional linear gradient end color for module fill.

members.name: gradientAngle
members.description: Gradient angle in degrees (0 = left→right, 90 = top→bottom).

members.name: logo
members.description: Center logo image URL or data URI. Setting this forces `ec-level` to `H`.

members.name: logoSize
members.description: Logo size as a fraction of the code's module span (clamped to a safe max of 0.3).

members.name: logoPadding
members.description: Extra knockout padding around the logo, as a fraction of one module.

members.name: logoBackground
members.description: Knockout plate color behind the logo. Falls back to the `--fluid-qr-logo-bg` token.

members.name: logoRadius
members.description: Corner radius (in modules) of the logo knockout plate.

members.name: artistic
members.description:
Artistic mode: render `logo` as a full-bleed background image and draw the
data modules as semi-opaque dots on top, like a halftone overlay. Forces
`ec-level` to `H` and keeps the finder eyes solid for scannability.
Scannability caveat: artistic codes are decorative-first; always test scan
reliability with a real phone before shipping one in production.

members.name: artisticOpacity
members.description: Opacity of the modules in artistic mode (0 to 1).

type.text: { value: string; level: EcLevel; result: QRCode | null } | undefined

members.name: effectiveEcLevel
members.description: The effective error-correction level after logo/artistic overrides.

members.name: eyeOrigins
members.description: The three finder-pattern origins for a code of `count` modules.

members.name: isInEye
members.description: True when (r, c) lies inside any of the three 7×7 finder patterns.

members.name: modulePaint
members.description: Paint for the data modules: gradient ref when both ends are set, else flat color.

members.name: resolveGap
members.description: Resolve the inter-module gap (fraction of one module) from the token, clamped to [0, 0.4].

members.name: renderModule
members.description: Render one data module at module coords (x, y) with the active shape.

members.name: renderEye
members.description: Render one finder eye (outer frame ring + inner pupil) at its origin.

members.name: renderLogo
members.description: Render the center logo (knockout plate + image).

members.name: logoKnockout

type.text: { x0: number; y0: number; x1: number; y1: number } | null

members.description: Module coords covered by the logo knockout, so we skip drawing them.

members.name: serializeSvg
members.description: Serialize the current shadow-DOM SVG to a standalone markup string.

members.name: toDataURL
members.description:
Rasterize the rendered SVG to a PNG data URL. Resolves to an empty-string
fallback only if there is nothing to render. Note: when the SVG embeds a
cross-origin `logo`/image without CORS headers, the canvas becomes tainted
and export will reject; serve such images same-origin or with CORS.

members.name: download
members.description: Rasterize and trigger a browser download of the PNG.
